tagline: A premier distributor of specialty food and center-of-the-plate products
hero_kpi_rationale: Major growth of 140% over 4 years ($1.7B in 2021 to $4.1B in 2025), reflecting a strategy of targeted acquisitions and geographic expansion in a consolidating industry. Revenue is the primary driver in a physical distribution sector without distinctive technology exposure.

kpis.name: Net Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in sales year-over-year, accounting for volume and pricing.
kpis.description: Revenue grew from $1.7B in 2021 to $4.1B in 2025, a 140% increase over 4 years.
kpis.signal: Massive 4-year growth driven by acquisitions and expansion.

kpis.name: Number of distribution facilities
kpis.explanation: Number of warehouses used to store and deliver products.
kpis.description: The company operated 44 distribution facilities as of December 26, 2025, reflecting steady expansion in recent years.

kpis.name: Storage capacity (square feet)
kpis.explanation: Total warehouse space available for product storage.
kpis.description: Total capacity of approximately 3.1 million square feet across 44 sites.
kpis.signal: Significant logistics capacity to support growth.

kpis.name: Number of SKUs
kpis.explanation: Number of distinct products available for sale.
kpis.description: Over 90,000 SKUs available, sourced from more than 4,000 suppliers.
kpis.signal: Extensive product portfolio, key for demanding chefs.

kpis.name: Customers (establishments)
kpis.explanation: Number of restaurants and foodservice establishments served.
kpis.description: The company serves over 55,000 establishments, primarily independent restaurants and high-end venues.
kpis.signal: Large customer base in the premium segment.

kpis.signal: Targeted acquisition strategy to strengthen regional penetration.

risks.title: Dependence on general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the 'Business and Macroeconomic Risk' section. The language used ('significant extent', 'materially adversely affect') indicates high concern. It is weighted by the nature of the industry (food-away-from-home), which is sensitive to discretionary spending.

risks.title: Margin pressure in a low-margin sector
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed immediately after macroeconomic risk, highlighting margin sensitivity to cost fluctuations. The phrase 'relatively low profit margins' and the impact of inflation/deflation on profitability are key indicators.

risks.title: Intense competition and low customer switching costs
risks.score_rationale: The 'significant competition' section describes a fragmented market with numerous players and low barriers to entry. Low customer switching costs and pricing pressure are explicitly cited as major risks.

risks.title: Dependence on suppliers and supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is extensively detailed, covering disruptions, cost increases, and unforeseen events (weather, political, pandemics). The absence of long-term supplier contracts and lack of hedging instruments are critical points.

risks.title: Rising labor costs and shortage of qualified personnel
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented as a factor that could 'slow our growth or harm our business'. The significance of labor costs, risk of increased unionization, and difficulty attracting/retaining qualified staff are emphasized.

risks.title: Volatility in fuel and transportation costs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly mentioned as potentially having a 'material adverse effect'. It impacts both company costs and consumer confidence, indirectly affecting demand.

risks.title: Risks related to supplier relationships and credit terms
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the macroeconomic section but specifically concerns supplier/credit relationships. The potential impact of a credit profile change on supplier payment terms is considered a liquidity risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CHEF does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
